personality: 4 Tactile / Playful LIGHT (Adapted for Seniors: high contrast, large UI, warm earthy palette)
personality_one_liner: A warm, reassuring, and highly readable space that feels like a friendly companion, avoiding any clinical or 'senior' stereotypes.

spacing.rule: Generous spacing. Min 16px between interactive elements to accommodate fine motor control. Large touch targets.

dont's: Do not use glass or blur anywhere. Flat, high-contrast surfaces are critical for elderly cognitive clarity.

screens.name: Home
screens.purpose: Full-screen vertical reels feed for discovering wellbeing, recipes, and travel.

states.loading: Centered warm orange spinner on dark background (since reels are full-screen).
states.empty: Illustration of a sunny day, 'No new videos right now', 'Refresh' button.
states.error: Readable error message, 'Tap to retry' button.

screens.layout: Full-screen video player (like Instagram Reels). Top safe area contains horizontal scrolling category chips (All, Exercise, Yoga, etc.). 'All' chip is brandPrimary, others are surfaceInverse with borderStrong. Right-rail stack for actions (Heart, Save, Share, Voice Mic). Bottom safe area contains Creator info (avatar, name), large title ('5-Minute Morning Stretch'), 2-line description, and a '^ Swipe for next' hint. All text on video must use a gradient scrim (top-to-bottom transparent to 80% surfaceInverse) to ensure AAA readability.

screens.name: News
screens.purpose: A hub for Family Updates (Stories) and Today's News (Feed).

states.empty: Illustration of a newspaper, 'No news today', 'Refresh' button.
states.error: Readable error message, 'Tap to retry' button.

screens.layout: Top section: 'Family Updates' horizontal scrolling list of large story circles (min 72x72) with labels (Daughter, Son, Voice Note). Below: 'Today's News' vertical feed of large cards. Each card has a large image, category tag, large title, and date. Cards use surfaceSecondary on surface background, with shadow_tier 1. Use generous md (16px) padding between all elements.

screens.name: Health
screens.purpose: Large, clear dashboard for medicines, appointments, and emergency SOS.

states.empty: Illustration of a health cross, 'All caught up', 'Add Medicine' button.
states.error: Readable error message, 'Tap to retry' button.

screens.layout: Header: Large greeting 'Good morning, Kamala'. Top right: profile avatar. Top section: Huge, full-width red SOS button ('error' color) for emergencies. Below: Grid or list of large rounded cards (Medicines, Appointments, Doctor, My Care). Each card needs an icon, large label, and simple secondary text ('2 due today'). Avoid complex charts. Use high contrast for all text.

screens.name: Profile
screens.purpose: User settings, accessibility toggles, and 'I'm Okay' reassurance.

states.error: Readable error message, 'Tap to retry' button.

screens.layout: Top section: Profile picture, Name, and a prominent 'I'm Okay' success-colored button to alert family. Below: A list of setting rows (Saved Videos, Accessibility, Notifications, Help). Each row uses a tinted icon container, large text, and a chevron. Rows must have min 56pt height and clear dividers.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use standard React Native components instead of web idioms. Ensure touch targets are huge (min 56x56) using hitSlop or direct sizing.
Typography must be massive (base 18pt, lg 22pt) to cater to elderly users. Do NOT use small metadata fonts.
Contrast is critical: Avoid pure white backgrounds to reduce glare, use the specified off-white/cream palette. Do not use glass/blur effects as they cause cognitive confusion for seniors.

Home screen: Must perfectly match the reference screenshot requirements. Full-screen reels with top category chips (active chip in warm orange). Bottom safe area has a dark-to-transparent vertical gradient scrim so white text on the video remains legible.
Reels must implement right-rail action buttons (Heart, Save, Share, Voice Mic). Voice AI feature should show a bottom sheet or a simple overlay when tapped.
Health Screen: The SOS button must be instantly recognizable, huge, and use the 'error' red color. The simulated SOS flow should trigger a fake 'Family Alerted' toast/bottom sheet.
News Screen: Implement Instagram-style horizontal stories for family updates. Ensure avatar circles are very large.
Include 'I'm Okay' one-tap reassurance action prominently on the Profile screen.
Haptics: Provide tactile feedback on all interactive elements (chips, SOS button, I'm okay button, Reels actions) to assist users with declining fine motor control.
